news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (Funds I and II, via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, based on 86.09 million shares outstanding after the July 2, 2026 offering. It confirms that a dedicated biotech specialist held on through the large equity raise rather than selling into strength.

news.headline: Invus Entities Disclose 6.0% Beneficial Stake in Abivax
news.summary: Long-standing shareholder Invus (together with the Avicenna Fund) reported 4,825,759 ordinary shares and ADSs, equal to 6.0% of Abivax as of June 30, 2026. Alongside the TCG filing it rounds out an August picture of a stable, concentrated institutional register ahead of the NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA by the end of 2026, removing a key procedural uncertainty.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its target well above the prevailing share price, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod UC data package and the NDA timeline after the maintenance results and pre-NDA FDA feedback. It was one of several sell-side hikes that have pushed the consensus target to roughly $160-166 (Piper Sandler and Guggenheim at $175).

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax hired four senior commercial executives covering marketing, patient services, sales operations and market access/pricing to build a standalone U.S. commercial organization ahead of a potential obefazimod launch. The move signals the company is preparing to launch on its own rather than depending on a partner or acquirer.

news.headline: Abivax $920 Million Cash Haul Lets It Prepare for Solo U.S. Launch Instead of Relying on a Buyer, CEO Tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel said the upsized $920 million raise (closed July 6, ~$874 million net, priced at $125 per ADS) funds Abivax into Q4 2029 and lets it build U.S. launch infrastructure itself rather than accept a takeover. He did not rule out a deal but framed the raise as removing pressure to sell, against persistent buyout chatter that some analysts have modelled at up to $23 billion.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results and pipeline update
catalysts.detail: Abivax normally reports half-year results in September. The update should refresh the post-raise cash position (guided into Q4 2029), R&D spend trajectory, NDA-preparation progress and U.S. pre-launch commercial build-out. No exact date has been announced by the company yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction and 44-week maintenance data and the constructive pre-NDA meeting (July 30, 2026), Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax has guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe alongside the U.S. NDA, contingent on the (now positive) maintenance data. The company's most recent communication emphasises the Q4 2026 FDA filing and has not restated a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (enrollment started Q3 2024). A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision on the obefazimod NDA
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted; this remains the ultimate approval and launch catalyst for the equity.

pulse: Abivax has fully recovered from its post-financing wobble: the ADS trades around $120-121 as of August 19, 2026 (market cap ~$10.4bn, 52-week range $67-$149), right back at the $120 strike after dipping near $103 in early August. The story is now almost entirely execution rather than science - Phase 3 ABTECT induction and 44-week maintenance data are positive (including refractory patients), the July 30 pre-NDA meeting confirmed FDA alignment on an end-2026 NDA filing, and the $920m raise funds a solo U.S. launch into Q4 2029, with August news flow limited to 13G filings showing TCG Crossover at 7.0% and Invus at 6.0%. For the March-2027 $120 call the position is roughly at-the-money and hinges on the Q4 2026 NDA submission landing on time, the September H1 report, mid-2027 Crohn's expectations building early, and whether renewed takeover speculation or a re-rating toward the ~$166 average analyst target pushes shares decisively above the strike before expiry.
